question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. 

Having or showing no emotion
solution: TB Solution: The correct answer is **'Apathetic'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • 'Apathetic** (उदासीन)' **means **showing no interest or energy and being unwilling to take action, especially over something important.****​** -Example: When we lose touch with our authentic desire, we become listless and **apathetic**. So it is clear that **'****Apathetic'** can be used as a one-word substitute for **'Having or showing no emotion'.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Sympathetic** means showing that you understand other people’s feelings, especially their problems.** (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण)** • **Compassionate** means feeling or showing sympathy and sadness for the suffering or bad luck of others, and wanting to help them.**(करुणाशील)** • **Empathetic **means showing an ability to understand and share the feelings of another. **(सहानुभूतिशील)** ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1. e8:Tf95, TB Solution:
